The '''command pod''' was a section aboard the [[Terminus-class destroyer]] ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', an advanced [[Warship/Legends|warship]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] commissioned around [[3643 BBY]]. Composed of a complex network of biomechanical interfaces, it was used by [[Darth Karrid]] for private [[holocomm]]unications.
